evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Build a PivotViewer by region and show copies per edition. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Use PivotViewer to compare members of a collection at a chosen dimension. The dimension extracts a stable grouping value; card values carry the measures, not the group identity.
assertions: Define a known coordinate before rendering. Done: the three editions include two in East and one in West, each with its own copies measure.
Give each card a stable key; use the same getter for a filter and dimension sharing a key. Done: filtering by region compares region values, not formatted count labels.
